question: According to the 2011 census, which of the following states had the highest literacy rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala** had the highest literacy rate according to the 2011 census.
 
• Kerala's literacy rate was reported at approximately **93.91%**.
 
• The state has consistently topped the literacy charts in India due to its robust education system and high emphasis on education.
 
• Kerala's high literacy rate is a result of various government initiatives and the state's social structure which prioritizes education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **2011 Census** of India was the 15th National census since 1871.
 
• The census is conducted by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India, under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• Literacy rate in India is defined as the percentage of people aged seven years and above who can read and write with understanding.
 
• Other states with high literacy rates following Kerala include **Lakshadweep, Mizoram, and Tripura**.
 
• Efforts to improve literacy rates in India include the National Literacy Mission, Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan, and various state-level initiatives.
